Full summary: Processed field measurements-back doc: D13 ask 1 (commit-provenance derivation) withdrawn by field and accepted as dead — 1:1 bail fires on 96.3% of their backlog, migration-commit poison band, semantic wall. Re-scoped to scope-expansion confirmation workflow.
Decisions: Accepted the field's withdrawal of D13 ask 1 as specified and dropped commit archaeology entirely — their measurements kill it three ways (574 empties share 109 SHAs so the 1:1 bail fires on 96.3%; the sqlite-migration commit poisons 162 mirror-file derivations toward .mcp.json; affected_files means governed-prose in their corpus while provenance yields session-touched files, majority analysis/ scratch). Replaces the earlier ask-4-then-derivation sequencing: the accepted shape is scope-to-candidate-file expansion ranked by term overlap with per-record CONFIRMATION, twining_amend as the write path; the forward diff-capture at record-tools.ts:48 survives only as a derived-marked candidate field, never authoritative affected_files
